prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions tended to overestimate positive impact in early rounds, but underestimated gains in winning tests in rounds 3 and 4.
home wait_info changes are helpful, backed by 2 agreeing winning tests in rounds 3 and 4.
sign_in hint changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing early tests, though round 4 yielded a winning test.
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign as its 3 tests do not agree (one won, one showed no clear effect, and one performed worse).
Evidence remains thin for finish new_screen as its 2 tests do not agree (one was rolled back due to guardrail limits, one showed no clear effect).
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path new_flow, finish copy, finish new_flow, home notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only one test so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.8% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, new_flow: -5.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -4.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +2.8% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +2.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Interactive Activity Stream: Displays real-time animated status updates and cycling companion tips during desktop render waiting time. (why: Home step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s. Home wait_info improvements have proven effective in past rounds.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Custom Pet Crafting Interactive Studio: Rebuilds the pick_friend screen using a stage layout featuring live animated pet previews and custom trait options. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 66.2% with an 89s median time, and 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation errors or visual glitches.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Reminder Hint: Adds an explicit sync reminder hint on the sign-in screen informing users how existing pets are restored upon authentication. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Archetype Orientation Screen: Inserts an archetype overview screen prior to path selection to explain the difference between instant adoption and custom photo generation. (why: Choose path drops 20.4% of users with a high mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion between pathways.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Progress Notification Banner: Updates the waiting screen to show step-by-step rendering progress notifications and setup completion readiness cues. (why: Home wait times are very high (mean 2336s), and wait_info changes have strong historical test evidence.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Control Master Class Flow: Adds a secondary controls walkthrough step after home_intro demonstrating shortcut keys, system tray hiding, and audio controls. (why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls, and finish conversion is low (64.8%).)
6: [sign_in, redesign] Account Recovery and Authentication Hub Redesign: Redesigns sign_in into a split layout clearly separating new account creation from existing pet account recovery. (why: 8 emails reported missing/reset pets on sign-in and 2 reported sign-in stalls or missing screens.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Dual Column Path Choice Grid: Reformats choose_path into a two_column layout contrasting pet selection options, render expectations, and customization choices. (why: Choose path takes 514s mean time, suggesting users struggle to compare options in the standard layout.)

scores.note: Home step has extreme wait times; home wait_info changes have strong historical evidence (+2.8%), but full animated UI requires release work.
Adoption has a high drop rate (33.8%) and support tickets, but adoption redesigns have conflicting results and thin confidence.
Strong alignment between support complaints (8 emails) and funnel drop; hint changes are low-cost config with recent winning tests.
Choose path drops 20.4%, but adding new intermediate screens historically reduces conversion across test flow variants.
Addresses long render wait times using a proven home wait_info pattern with two prior winning tests.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users and has support complaints, but new flow changes in finish step previously regressed conversion.
High evidence from support emails, but major layout redesigns/reorders on sign_in have performed poorly in past tests.
Addresses high median/mean duration on choose_path; single past layout test showed mild gain (+1.5%), though evidence is thin.
